speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent; can you tell me when the weakness in your right leg and the unsteadiness in your gait first started? Also, have you noticed any changes in your memory or mood over the past few months?

speaker: Patient
text: 44-year-old male. The patient's daughter reports a 1-week history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and multiple falls. Over the past 6 months, the patient has been increasingly forgetful, losing his way on familiar routes and facing difficulties operating simple kitchen appliances. He has also been paranoid, agitated, and restless recently.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you or your family notice any changes in your vision, such as blurred sight or double vision? Have you experienced any headaches, nausea, or seizures recently?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Right leg weakness and unsteady gait. I also have Forgetfulness, Paranoid and agitated behavior, Difficulty in using kitchen appliances.

speaker: Doctor
text: I need to check if there are any issues with your other senses or movements; have you noticed any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your arms or face? Additionally, have you experienced any recent fevers, weight loss, or a history of cancer?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Known history of HIV, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Noncompliance with medications for over 2 years. Social history: Information not provided

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of untreated HIV and recent neurological changes, I need to rule out an opportunistic infection or tumor in your brain. REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with contrast. REQUEST TEST: HIV Viral Load and CD4 Count.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI Brain: Disseminated, nonenhancing white matter lesions with no mass effect. HIV Viral Load: > 100,000 copies/mL. CD4+ Count: 56/μL. Additional findings: Temperature 37.2 °C, Blood Pressure 152/68 mm Hg, Heart Rate 98/min, Respiratory Rate 14/min. Mental Status: Somnolent, slightly confused. Motor: Right lower extremity weakness. Hemoglobin: 9.2 g/dL. Leukocyte Count: 3600/mm3. Platelet Count: 140,000/mm3. Toxoplasma gondii IgG: Positive. Serum Cryptococcal Antigen: Negative.

speaker: Doctor
text: The MRI findings of nonenhancing white matter lesions combined with your severely low CD4 count and high viral load are highly indicative of Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to advanced HIV/AIDS.
